title: Orphan Graphics Toys: FPGA raycast, color waves, XOR and Life
summary: A compact FPGA graphics playground for the CYD Wi-Fi display and web browser. Wall tracing, projection and pixel shading run in the FPGA; ARM uploads view vectors and transports the framebuffer. Includes color waves, XOR fields and Ardzy's hardware Game of Life. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.
